class.name: MySQLAsyncOperation
class.description: Returned immediately by [method MySQLSession.async_execute_text] and [method MySQLSession.async_execute_prepared], before the server has answered. Wait for it by awaiting [signal completed] only if [method is_finished] is still [code]false[/code] (otherwise read [method get_result] directly): [signal completed] fires only once, so if the operation already finished while something else was being awaited, a bare [code]await async_op.completed[/code] would never return. Alternatively, poll [method is_finished] across frames (driven by [method Object.call_deferred] under the hood, so it only progresses while the [SceneTree] is processing frames, never from a busy [code]while[/code] loop). Once finished, [method get_result] returns the same [MySQLResult] that [signal completed] carries.

method.name: get_result
method.description: The [MySQLResult] of this operation, or [code]null[/code] if it has not finished yet (check [method is_finished] first).

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once [signal completed] has fired and [method get_result] is available.

signal.name: completed
signal.description: Emitted once, when the operation finishes (successfully or not), and never again. [code]result[/code] is the same [MySQLResult] [method get_result] then returns. Check [method is_finished] before awaiting it (see the class description).
